title: Frontend: Age calculator
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Age calculator. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App. Compute completed calendar years using Birthday and Today (YYYY-MM-DD). Invalid dates/future birthday show Invalid date. In a non-leap year a February-29 birthday advances on March 1. Return the integer age. Render controlled labelled inputs with these exact names: Birthday, Today. A Calculate submit button computes the result. Render JSON.stringify(result) in [data-testid="result"]. Validation failure clears result and shows the documented message in [data-testid="error"].
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Validate date fields and reject future birthdays.
alternativeApproaches: Show years/months/days with an explicit calendar borrowing policy rather than fixed-duration arithmetic.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Birthday today; birthday tomorrow; year boundary.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
